AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Air Conditioning System Circuit     AC-9

AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM CIRCUIT

[This page contains a detailed electrical wiring diagram for the air conditioning system. The diagram shows various components and their connections including:

- 14 ACS SENSOR
- WET BULB SENSOR
- IN CAR SENSOR
- SOLAR SENSOR
- BLOWER MOTOR
- BLOWER SWITCH
- COMPRESSOR MOTOR
- COOLING CONTROL
- VOLTAGE CONTROL
- RESISTOR
- POWER SOURCE
- BLOWER SWITCH
- VENT MODE SWITCH
- HEAT MODE SWITCH
- WATER TEMP SWITCH (MTF)
- WATER TEMP SWITCH (120°F)
- HEATER VALVE
- WATER VALVE
- CONDENSER MOTOR
- A/C FAN
- SUB DAMPER RELAY [?]

The diagram uses dotted lines to indicate:
- ORIGINAL EQUIPPED WIRE HARNESS
- A.C. WIRE HARNESS]
